reasoning_content:
The script is the official mise installer. Let me check its default install location to know where it goes. It installs to ~/.local/bin typically. Let me just run it. But first check version pinned in mise.lock.

Let me look at mise.lock to see channel/version. Also check arch.

action.command: uname -m; echo "---"; head -40 /workspace/mise.lock; echo "..."; grep -n "mise" /workspace/mise.lock | head; echo "---check install dir---"; grep -n "install_path\|MISE_INSTALL_PATH\|\.local/bin" /tmp/mise_install.sh | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "uname -m; echo \"---\"; head -40 /workspace/mise.lock; echo \"...\"; grep -n \"mise\" /workspace/mise.lock | head; echo \"---check install dir---\"; grep -n \"install_path\\|MISE_INSTALL_PATH\\|\\.local/bin\" /tmp/mise_install.sh | head", "summary": "Check arch and mise.lock details"}
